title: Account profiles show the next Pollen reset
summary:
Account profiles gained a Pollen reset timestamp, Flux Klein editing requests got the right shape, and two docs corrections tidied up the edges.

The account profile response gained `nextResetAt`, an ISO 8601 timestamp for the next daily Pollen reset. It returns `null` when no tier grant has been recorded. A follow-up corrected the documented account paths and curl examples to use `/account/` rather than `/api/account/`.

Flux Klein image editing requests now put the prompt, dimensions, and optional seed in the URL query, with a JSON array of base64 images in the POST body. Width and height still default to 1024.

The Code of Conduct now directs reports of abusive or harassing behavior to the current core team address.

daily.title: Know your Pollen reset
daily.text: The account profile response now includes `nextResetAt`, an ISO 8601 timestamp for your next daily Pollen reset. It returns `null` if no tier grant has been recorded yet. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
